description: Mid reviewer finds one stream bug but misses backpressure and memory leak. Mixed technical depth.

prContext.title: Add bulk CSV export endpoint
prContext.description: GET /api/export/csv streams candidate data as CSV.
prContext.instructions: Review for performance and memory safety.

groundTruth.description: SELECT * loads entire candidates table into memory. For 100k candidates this OOMs. Should stream rows or paginate.
No backpressure handling — c.body may buffer the entire CSV in memory before sending. Should use ReadableStream.
No auth check — any unauthenticated user can export all candidate data. GDPR breach risk.
Missing CSV header row — exported file has no column names.

reviewer_comments.what: Loading entire table into memory will OOM on large datasets.
reviewer_comments.why: Need pagination or streaming for production data.

reviewer_comments.what: CSV is missing a header row.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Memory issue is blocking. Header row should be added.

implementer_responses.updated_code: for (let offset = 0; ; offset += 1000) { const page = await c.env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM candidates LIMIT 1000 OFFSET ?1").bind(offset).all(); ... }

issue_identification.rationale: Found 2 of 4 bugs (memory, header). Missed backpressure and auth. Level 2-3.

prioritization.rationale: Memory flagged as blocking. Header as suggestion. Good triage. Level 3-4.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Accepted pagination fix without verifying it handles large datasets. Level 2-3.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete performance rationale (OOM). Good technical framing. Level 3-4.

question_formation.rationale: No explicit questions but implied concern about scale. Level 2-3.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested pagination and headers — actionable. Level 3-4.
